scope: O Fim anime humanoid-spacetime-rift manifestation: portrait and four ability scenes.
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, one call per asset; Pillow used only for WebP export and internal QA contact sheet.
canon: No fixed face or universal form. Each observer sees their own greatest fear. These assets depict one possible manifestation.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final boss portrait for PMA Post Mortem Arena. Input image: the previous O Fim art, reference for the infernal setting and unstable reality ONLY. Redesign the dominant presence according to the user's direction. O Fim appears as a terrifying HUMANOID silhouette fused with a tear in spacetime. One head, two long shadow arms, broad asymmetrical shoulders; the face is an utterly pitch-black featureless void, no eyes, no mouth, no nose, no mask. His body is living shadow, not flesh, armor or clothing: chest and abdomen are torn into a clear enormous spiraling negative-space vortex, with black shadow ribbons and sharp white-violet reality fractures orbiting it. His lower body dissolves into that gravitational spiral rather than ordinary legs. The outline fractures and trails into the surroundings, as if time is being dragged behind him; nearby cathedral fragments bend around his presence. Threatening forward advance, imposing scale, lowered empty head looking toward viewer, partly extended shadow hands with clean readable anatomy. Keep the infernal ruined cathedral, crimson eclipse, soot black, bone-white and violet light as supporting backdrop; the humanoid entity must be the distinct main subject, not just a scenery rupture. STRICT STYLE: unmistakable hand-drawn 2D ANIME key visual, bold precise dark ink contours, large graphic silhouettes, crisp flat cel shading with only 2-3 values per surface, sharp stylized energy arcs. No realistic stone grain, no photorealism, no painterly texture, no 3D rendering. Square composition, full entity silhouette from head to dissolving vortex comfortably in frame, head in upper central quarter and abdomen vortex prominent in center, high readability at card size. No crown, no skull, no permanent facial features, no mouth-shaped rift, no human skin, no text or watermark. This is one possible manifestation of a being that takes each observer's greatest fear, never a canonical true face.
